bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to natural resources; prohibiting the commissioner of natural resources from limiting number of native rough fish taken in one day or number possessed; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 97C.401, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 97C.401, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

[+Subd. 4.+]

[+Native rough fish.+]

[+Notwithstanding subdivision 1, the commissioner must not prescribe limits on the number of native rough fish that may be taken in one day or the number that may be possessed. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to natural resources; prohibiting the commissioner of natural resources from limiting number of native rough fish taken in one day or number possessed; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 97C.401, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 97C.401, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 4.

Native rough fish.

Notwithstanding subdivision 1, the commissioner must not prescribe limits on the number of native rough fish that may be taken in one day or the number that may be possessed.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: Notwithstanding subdivision 1, the commissioner must not prescribe limits on the number of native rough fish that may be taken in one day or the number that may be possessed.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
